trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for ECOMMERCE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- order_tracking: Explain where an order is, why it is delayed, and what the customer's options are.
- returns_refunds: Assess return eligibility, schedule pickup and explain the refund route and timeline.

Business context:
- order_tracking: Indian marketplace contact centre. Callers chase deliveries, raise returns and dispute refunds. Return windows, pickup scheduling and refund routes are policy-bound.
- returns_refunds: Indian marketplace contact centre. Callers chase deliveries, raise returns and dispute refunds. Return windows, pickup scheduling and refund routes are policy-bound.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [order_tracking]
  - Scan truth: Delivery status may only be described from the courier scan the tool returns.
  - No delivery promises: The agent must not promise a delivery day the tools do not support.
  - Complaint window: A not-delivered complaint may only be raised once the promised window has elapsed.
  - COD handling: A COD order carries no refund until it is returned and received.
  [returns_refunds]
  - Eligibility first: No pickup or refund may be arranged before check_return_eligibility returns eligible.
  - Route truth: The refund route and credit time must be the ones the tool returns.
  - Replacement-only categories: Where the route is replacement_only, a refund must not be offered.
  - Refund after pickup: For a returned item the refund follows pickup; the agent must not imply it comes first.

Tools available to you (7): check_return_eligibility, issue_refund, lookup_order, raise_delivery_complaint, schedule_pickup, track_shipment, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: hi-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: check_return_eligibility
model_visible_tools.description: Apply the category return policy to an order and return the window and route.

model_visible_tools.name: issue_refund
model_visible_tools.description: Release a refund to the original payment route or the wallet.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_order
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve order contents, value, payment mode and current fulfilment status.

model_visible_tools.name: raise_delivery_complaint
model_visible_tools.description: Open a delivery complaint with a resolution timeline.

model_visible_tools.name: schedule_pickup
model_visible_tools.description: Book a reverse-pickup slot for an eligible return.

model_visible_tools.name: track_shipment
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve courier scan history and the current delivery exception if any.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Says at the outset how little time they have.
Interrupts a long explanation to ask for the outcome.
Accepts a callback rather than waiting.
Will not sit through an options list.

steps.purpose: State urgency and ask for order status.
steps.text: Hello, मेरे पास बिल्कुल time नहीं है। मेरा order कहाँ है? मुझे जल्दी बताओ।

steps.purpose: Acknowledge and ask for order ID.
steps.expected_behavior: Agent should ask for the order ID in Hindi without switching to English.
steps.text: नमस्ते, मैं आपकी मदद करता हूँ। क्या आप मुझे अपना order ID बता सकते हैं?
steps.planner_rationale: The agent greets the customer and requests the order ID to proceed.

steps.text: हाँ, ORD-30003। जल्दी check करो, मैं meeting में जा रहा हूँ।

steps.expected_behavior: Agent should ask for the registered pincode in Hindi.
steps.text: धन्यवाद। मैं details check करने से पहले एक verification करूँगा। क्या आप अपना registered pincode बता सकते हैं?
steps.planner_rationale: The agent asks for a verification factor before accessing order details.

steps.text: Pincode 400001 है। देखिए, मुझे लंबा process नहीं चाहिए।

steps.purpose: Verify customer identity using the provided pincode.
steps.expected_behavior: Agent should invoke verify_customer_identity with correct arguments.
steps.planner_rationale: The agent calls the verification tool using the order ID and pincode provided.

steps.purpose: Acknowledge verification and state intent to check order.
steps.expected_behavior: Agent should politely inform the user that they are checking the order.
steps.text: Verification के लिए शुक्रिया। मैं अभी आपका order check करता हूँ।
steps.planner_rationale: The agent acknowledges successful verification and proceeds to check the order.

steps.expected_behavior: Agent should invoke lookup_order with the provided order ID.
steps.planner_rationale: The agent calls lookup_order to find the current fulfillment status.

steps.expected_behavior: Agent should state the order details relying solely on the tool output.
steps.text: आपका 3299 rupees का running shoes का order अभी out for delivery है।
steps.planner_rationale: The agent shares the item, amount, and status exactly as returned by the tool.

steps.purpose: Ask for confirmation of delivery today.
steps.text: तो आज मिलेगा ना? मैं office निकलने वाला हूँ।

steps.purpose: State intent to check courier tracking.
steps.expected_behavior: Agent should inform the user before checking tracking details.
steps.text: मैं courier की tracking details check कर लेता हूँ ताकि exact scan पता चल सके।
steps.planner_rationale: The agent decides to check the courier scan to provide an accurate answer about today's delivery.

steps.expected_behavior: Agent should invoke track_shipment with the order ID.
steps.planner_rationale: The agent calls track_shipment to get the latest courier scan.

steps.expected_behavior: Agent should ground its response entirely in the track_shipment tool output.
steps.text: BlueDart courier के scan के मुताबिक, आपका parcel आज out for delivery है। AWB number BD123456 है।
steps.planner_rationale: The agent provides the exact courier name, scan status, and AWB number from the tool result.

steps.purpose: Request to raise a complaint in advance.
steps.text: अगर आज नहीं आया तो? आप एक delivery complaint raise कर दीजिए अभी advance में।

steps.purpose: Refuse to raise complaint due to business rules.
steps.expected_behavior: Agent should enforce the business rule and use the exact days_since_order and promised_days from the tool.
steps.text: मैं अभी complaint raise नहीं कर सकता क्योंकि आपके order का promised time 4 दिन है, और अभी सिर्फ 2 दिन हुए हैं।
steps.planner_rationale: The agent refuses to raise a complaint because the promised window has not elapsed, citing exact days from the tool.

steps.purpose: Express urgency and inability to wait.
steps.text: लेकिन मुझे delivery आज चाहिए, मेरे पास time नहीं है wait करने का।
steps.clean_text: लेकिन मुझे delivery आज चाहिए, मेरे पास time नहीं है wait करने का।
steps.model_visible_text: लेकिन मुझे delivery आग चाहिए, मेरे पास time नहीं है wait करने का।

steps.purpose: Manage expectations without making unsupported promises.
steps.expected_behavior: Agent should maintain boundaries and not make delivery promises outside of the tool's scan.
steps.text: मैं समझ सकता हूँ कि आप जल्दी में हैं। Courier scan बता रहा है कि आज out for delivery है, पर मैं अलग से कोई date promise नहीं कर सकता।
steps.planner_rationale: The agent acknowledges the urgency but explicitly avoids promising a delivery date that isn't strictly guaranteed by the tools.

steps.text: अच्छा, ठीक है। मैं meeting में जा रहा हूँ, आप मुझे evening में callback कर सकते हैं क्या?

steps.purpose: Decline callback and suggest tracking online.
steps.expected_behavior: Agent should politely decline the callback request and suggest online tracking.
steps.text: हमारे पास callback की सुविधा नहीं है, लेकिन आप अपने AWB number से online track कर सकते हैं।
steps.planner_rationale: The agent informs the customer that callbacks are not supported and provides an alternative.

steps.text: Okay, fine. अगर नहीं मिला तो मैं कल वापस call करूँगा। Bye.

steps.expected_behavior: Agent should end the call courteously in Hindi.
steps.text: ज़रूर। Call करने के लिए धन्यवाद। आपका दिन शुभ हो।
steps.planner_rationale: The agent politely concludes the interaction.

ir.terminal_condition: Customer told exactly where the shipment is and what happens next.
